concerns.text: SC-005 ('computational resource usage is measured against the GitHub Actions free-tier limit... (See Assumptions)') anchors to the Assumptions section, not to any user story. No story's scope covers CI resource budgeting. Re-anchor it to a story (e.g. US-1 data extraction) or remove it as scope creep.

The Edge Cases section specifies required behavior — mixed-provenance PRs must be tagged 'Mixed' and excluded from the binary comparison, rate-limit backoff/pause-resume, and empty-repo exclusion with warning — but no FR covers any of these. US-1's scope (classification for the binary comparison) plainly includes mixed-provenance handling, so add an FR (e.g. FR-008) for the 'Mixed' tag/exclusion and rate-limit handling.

US-2 scenario 3 requires explicit null-result reporting ('No statistically significant difference found at α=0.05... rather than claiming equivalence without power analysis'), but no FR mandates this reporting behavior. FR-004/FR-005 cover test selection and effect size only. Add an FR or extend FR-004 to anchor this scenario.
